## The commit pass

<!-- Wymber runs this pass on every change. Tick what applies. -->

- [ ] **Tests green:** `pytest`, `vitest`; E2E added/updated for any UI change
- [ ] **E2E + UX walked:** `playwright test` ran, and a real browser walk-through of the affected app/landing screens (assessed the feel, not just green dots)
- [ ] **Issues triaged:** closed what's done, filed what surfaced; labels set (`type:` / `area:` / `priority:`)
- [ ] **Roadmap current:** priorities and epics adjusted if this moved them
- [ ] **Docs updated:** README / ADRs / CONTENT-GUIDELINES match reality; no stale references
- [ ] **Branch + author:** feature branch (not a direct main push); authored by Tamok; no em-dashes; gentle tone
